boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 44 is labeled 'Hard Level' and features a central `5` boss square sitting on a foundation row of four `5`-counter blocks at the bottom. Above the boss, small-counter blocks (cyan `1`, a `3` block) and a purple device must be cleared first to give the boss vertical room. The bottom `5` row and the boss collapse in coordination — the boss pushes down as the foundation thins. Pink blocks on the right are the late-phase cleanup.
landmarks: Block Out Level 44 is labeled 'Hard Level' and features a central `5` boss square sitting on a foundation row of four `5`-counter blocks at the bottom.
Above the boss, small-counter blocks (cyan `1`, a `3` block) and a purple device must be cleared first to give the boss vertical room.
The bottom `5` row and the boss collapse in coordination — the boss pushes down as the foundation thins.
Pink blocks on the right are the late-phase cleanup.

quickTips: The upper counters (`1` and `3`) are small but they gate the whole board — clear them first.
The boss and the bottom `5` row collapse together, so do not try to clear the foundation independently.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the cyan `1`-counter block at the top to create the first opening above the boss.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Service the purple device at the top of the board.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Remove the `3`-counter block to widen the upper space.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Start dropping the central `5` boss once the upper room is open.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Let the four `5` blocks at the bottom thin as the boss pushes down.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the pink blocks on the right side as the late-phase color.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the remaining bottom blocks and side exits after the boss is gone.

failurePoints: Trying to drop the `5` boss before the upper `1` and `3` counters are cleared — the boss has no room to move and the upper space stays sealed.
Disturbing the bottom `5` row before the boss has started dropping, which removes the support but leaves the boss stuck above with no path down.
